record.question: Uneasy lies __________ head that wears a crown.
record.explanation: Answer A: the. The familiar Shakespearean line is “Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown”; definite article the (A). Independent check: The fixed quotation is “Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown”; “the” is the definite article.
